blockers.title: Confirmation of Enrolment not yet received
blockers.user_message: You cannot lodge a Subclass 500 without a valid CoE from a CRICOS-registered provider. An offer letter is NOT a CoE — the CoE is issued after you accept and pay the deposit.
blockers.recommended_next_step: A valid Confirmation of Enrolment from a CRICOS-registered provider is mandatory. Your application cannot proceed without one — an offer letter is not a CoE.

blockers.title: CoE number not yet available for lodgement
blockers.user_message: The exact CoE number must be entered during lodgement. Keep the PDF from your provider handy.
blockers.recommended_next_step: The exact CoE number must be entered during lodgement in ImmiAccount. Keep the CoE PDF from your provider available.

blockers.title: Not all course stages have a CoE (packaged programs)
blockers.user_message: Packaged courses (common for pathway/foundation programs) need a CoE for each stage at lodgement.
blockers.recommended_next_step: For packaged or pathway programs, each course stage requires its own CoE at lodgement. A single CoE for only one stage is insufficient.

blockers.title: Institution not confirmed as CRICOS-registered
blockers.user_message: Many Pakistani students are mis-sold by agents into non-CRICOS providers. Verify the provider yourself on the official CRICOS register before paying anything.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Your institution must be registered on the CRICOS register. Verify the provider yourself at cricos.teqsa.gov.au before paying any agent or deposit.
blockers.rule_source_name: Full-Time Enrolment at CRICOS-Registered Institution Required

blockers.title: Course not confirmed as CRICOS-registered
blockers.user_message: The exact course must be CRICOS-registered, not only the university. Search your course title on the CRICOS register.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Your specific course — not just the institution — must be listed on the CRICOS register. Search the course title yourself at cricos.teqsa.gov.au.
blockers.rule_source_name: Full-Time Enrolment at CRICOS-Registered Institution Required

blockers.title: Enrolment is not full-time
blockers.user_message: Subclass 500 requires full-time study. Part-time enrolment is not eligible.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Subclass 500 requires full-time enrolment. Part-time enrolment is not eligible and your application cannot proceed on that basis.
blockers.rule_source_name: Full-Time Enrolment at CRICOS-Registered Institution Required

blockers.title: Genuine Student (GS) responses not yet prepared
blockers.user_message: Since March 2024 the old GTE statement is replaced by GS questions answered directly in the form (ties at home, why this course/Australia, course-career benefit, plus any relevant facts). Weak/generic GS answers are the No.1 refusal reason for Pakistani applicants.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Since March 2024, the GS questions in the application form replace the old GTE statement. Weak or generic GS answers are the leading refusal cause for Pakistani applicants.

blockers.title: Available funds fall short of the required total
blockers.user_message: Minimum = first-year tuition + AUD 29,710 living costs + ~AUD 2,500 airfare (plus extra for any dependants). Funds must be genuine and accessible, not just a number on paper.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Funds must cover first-year tuition + AUD 29,710 living costs + ~AUD 2,500 return airfare. They must be genuine, accessible, and consistently held — not just a number on paper.
blockers.rule_source_name: Financial Capacity — Must Cover Tuition, Living Costs, Travel

blockers.title: Funds may not cover tuition, living costs, and return airfare
blockers.user_message: This is the core financial-capacity test. Under-funding is a top refusal cause. Use current figures — the living cost rose from 24,505 to 29,710 in 2024.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Under-funding is a top refusal cause at Assessment Level 3. Your total evidence must cover tuition + AUD 29,710 living + return airfare, plus any dependant additions.
blockers.rule_source_name: Financial Capacity — Must Cover Tuition, Living Costs, Travel

blockers.title: Additional funds for dependants may not be evidenced
blockers.user_message: Add ~AUD 10,394 for a partner and ~AUD 4,449 per child to your required funds. Under-funding dependants invalidates the financial test.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Each dependant requires additional funds (~AUD 10,394 for a partner, ~AUD 4,449 per child). Under-funding dependants invalidates the financial test.
blockers.rule_source_name: Financial Capacity — Must Cover Tuition, Living Costs, Travel

blockers.title: Overseas Student Health Cover not yet arranged
blockers.user_message: OSHC is mandatory and must be from an approved Australian provider. Pakistani/local health insurance is NOT accepted.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Overseas Student Health Cover from an approved Australian provider is mandatory. Local Pakistani or international insurance is not accepted.

blockers.title: OSHC may not be from an approved Australian provider
blockers.user_message: Only the five approved Australian OSHC providers count. Verify before paying.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Only OSHC from one of the five approved Australian providers (Allianz, Bupa, Medibank, NIB, ahm) is accepted. Verify the provider before purchasing.

blockers.title: OSHC may not cover the full visa period
blockers.user_message: Cover must span your whole visa period, starting ~1 week before classes. Gaps in OSHC breach visa conditions.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Your OSHC must cover your full visa period, starting approximately one week before courses commence. Any gap in cover breaches visa conditions.

blockers.title: Valid English test result not yet obtained
blockers.user_message: A valid result is required unless genuinely exempt. Minimum IELTS 5.5 overall for the visa; your course often needs higher (6.0–7.0).
blockers.recommended_next_step: A valid approved English test result (IELTS, PTE, TOEFL iBT, or Cambridge) is required unless you are genuinely exempt. The visa minimum is IELTS 5.5 overall.

blockers.title: English score may not meet both course and visa requirements
blockers.user_message: Meeting the visa floor (IELTS 5.5) is not enough if your university needs 6.5. Both must be satisfied.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Your English score must satisfy both the visa minimum (IELTS 5.5) and your course's own requirement. Meeting only the visa floor is not sufficient if the course needs more.

blockers.title: Health examination not yet completed or booked
blockers.user_message: A health exam is mandatory. Pakistani applicants almost always need a chest X-ray for TB screening.
blockers.recommended_next_step: A health examination at an approved panel physician is mandatory. Pakistani applicants almost always require a chest X-ray for TB screening.

blockers.title: Health exam may not be from an approved panel physician
blockers.user_message: Only exams at approved panel clinics count. A cheaper local clinic's report is worthless for the visa and wastes money.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Only health examinations conducted by IRCC-approved panel physicians are accepted. A report from a local clinic not on the panel list is worthless for the visa.

blockers.title: Police clearances not yet obtained for all required countries
blockers.user_message: Pakistani applicants typically need a PCC from NADRA/local police; add clearances for any other country of long residence.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Pakistani applicants typically need a PCC from NADRA or local police. If you have lived abroad for 12+ months, you also need clearances from those countries.

blockers.title: Criminal or character history may not be fully disclosed
blockers.user_message: Hiding a character issue is an independent refusal ground — worse than the issue itself. Disclose everything.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Hiding a character issue is an independent refusal ground — often more damaging than the underlying matter itself. Disclose everything accurately.

blockers.title: Immigration history may not be fully disclosed
blockers.user_message: Non-disclosure of immigration history is an independent refusal ground and can trigger a re-entry ban (PIC 4020). Disclose everything, even old/minor matters.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Non-disclosure of immigration history is an independent refusal ground and can trigger a PIC 4020 three-year exclusion. Disclose everything, including old or minor matters.

blockers.title: New course is at a lower AQF level (Condition 8202 risk)
blockers.user_message: Dropping to a lower AQF level on the same visa breaches Condition 8202 and risks cancellation. You'd need a new Subclass 500.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Dropping to a lower AQF level on the same visa breaches Condition 8202 and risks visa cancellation. You would need to apply for a new Subclass 500.
blockers.rule_source_name: Course Must Be at the Same or Higher AQF Level (Condition 8202)
